verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms macOS has a built-in 'Remote Management'/'Remote Desktop' feature that can be used to access a Mac remotely (macos-comm-2), indicating the capability exists, but no first-party documentation in the pack describes Screen Sharing or Remote Desktop setup/use for the power-user story. missing for 10: official docs on enabling/using Screen Sharing or Remote Desktop, security guidance, and independent hands-on confirmation of normal (non-exploit) usage.
